text.p: AO Elektrosila's pre-tax profits dropped to 3.3 billion roubles in the first half of this year, a quarter of their level a year earlier, a company official said on Monday.
Six months ended June 30 1996 1995
Profit before tax (bln roubles) 3.3 13.6
Sales 181 68.4
Output (value) 225 115
Authorised capital is 383.2 billion roubles.
Deputy director Valentina Murinas told Reuters that delays by Elektrosila's customers in paying their bills were the reason for the fall in profits as output and sales grew.

"The situation with orders has turned out to be better this year, and we have orders for another two years. But customers are paying no better than in the past and are continuing to delay money transfers," she said.
Murinas said Elektrosila would not pay dividends for 1995 and it was uncertain if dividends would be paid for 1996.
Elektrosila produces generators for steam and hydro turbines.
Russia's Energomashinostroitelnaya Korporatsiya owns 36 percent and Germany's Siemens AG 20 percent of Elektrosila.

NOTE - Results according to Russian accounting standards, which designed to meet tax authorities' requirements. Companies can choose whether to show revenues and spending on a cash or accruals basis. Definitions of profit and assets differ from those used in the West, and converting Russian accounts to match international standards can turn a profit into a loss.
Figures are not adjusted for inflation or the depreciation of the rouble, but the following data may be helpful.
Dollar on Moscow Interbank Currency Exchange (MICEX):
June 28, 1996 5,105 roubles
Dec 29, 1995 4,640 roubles
June 30, 1995 4,539 roubles
Dec 29, 1994 3,550 roubles
Consumer prices in June 1996 were 14.5 percent higher than in December 1995. In June 1995 they were 108.5 percent higher than in December 1994.
